name: scripture-and-interpretation
description: Scripture interpretation across traditions — hermeneutics, exegesis, textual criticism, canonical formation, and the history of reading practices. Covers Jewish (Tanakh, Talmud, Midrash), Christian (Old and New Testament, patristic and medieval senses), Islamic (Qur'an, tafsir, asbab al-nuzul), and Daoist-Confucian classical commentary traditions. Use when a query involves reading a sacred or classical text, comparing how different traditions interpret the same passage, or understanding why a specific text is canonical to a specific community.
